admission.justification: Binds the five KNO-R13@v1 invariants spanning lockfile query pinning, out-of-process smoke-compiled highlighting, local-only custom queries, all seven code-serving surfaces, and foreground-only CodeMirror 6 Compartment rendering into one coherent cross-stack guarantee.

guarantee: Dashboard syntax highlighting across all seven code-serving surfaces uses one catalog-driven, server-computed tree-sitter pipeline without client-side @codemirror/lang-* packages or hardcoded extension tables. Highlight queries are SHA-256 pinned in language_catalog.lock.json (with presentation-only highlightLanguages and displaySuffixes separate from anchoring languages, plus local-only per-repo highlightsQueryPath) and never alter EXTRACTOR_VERSION. Every query bundle smoke-compiles out-of-process before in-process use, sweeps overlapping captures deterministically with @none and JSON key suppression under byte and span caps into \n-normalized UTF-16 spans, and degrades cleanly to null on binary, media, oversized, or unavailable inputs. Dashboard CodeMirror 6 viewers render those spans via foreground-only .cm-ar-tok-* Decoration.mark classes and per-side Compartments reconfigured by digest, preserving INV-QK8XNM editor retention and ChangeSetPane plain-mode suppression.
title: Unified server-computed tree-sitter syntax highlighting for dashboard viewers
